name: Default
shortDescription: Music collection manager that monitors artists, grabs new releases through your indexers and download clients, and organizes the library.

alerts.message: On first visit Lidarr asks you to create the login username and password. Open the app right after deploying so nobody else claims it, and keep Authentication Required set to Enabled: behind the proxy every visitor counts as a local address, so Disabled for Local Addresses leaves the app open.
